about: conc_steady.py prompt set v1: 64 measured + 8 warmup code prompts, each asking for a long answer so greedy decoding rarely stops before 256 tokens. The measured multiset is identical for every concurrency K; warmup prompts never appear in the measured set.
measure: Write a Python function that merges two sorted lists into one sorted list, with a docstring, type hints, and a set of pytest unit tests covering edge cases. Then explain its complexity in detail.
Write a Rust function that parses a CSV line into fields, handling quoted commas and escaped quotes. Include unit tests and a detailed explanation of the state machine.
Implement an LRU cache class in Python with get and put in O(1), using a dict and a doubly linked list written from scratch. Include tests and explain each method.
Write a C function that reverses a singly linked list in place, plus a small test harness in main() that builds, prints, reverses and frees a list. Explain the pointer manipulation step by step.
Write a TypeScript debounce function with generics, a matching throttle function, and Jest tests for both. Explain the difference between them in detail.
Write a Go function that computes the longest common subsequence of two strings using dynamic programming, reconstructs the subsequence, and includes table-driven tests. Explain the recurrence.
Write a SQL schema for employees and departments, insert sample data, then write a query that returns the top 3 salaries per department using window functions, and explain every clause.
Implement binary search in Python, prove its loop invariant, then add lower_bound and upper_bound variants with tests for duplicates and empty lists.
Implement a min-heap priority queue in Java from scratch with insert, peek, extractMin and heapify, plus a main method that tests it. Explain sift-up and sift-down.
Write a C++ class template for a fixed-capacity ring buffer with push, pop, front, back, size and iterators. Include a test program and explain the index arithmetic.
Implement Dijkstra's shortest path algorithm in Python with heapq, returning both distances and paths. Include a sample graph, tests, and a discussion of complexity and negative edges.
Write a JavaScript module that implements a simple event emitter with on, off, once and emit, plus unit tests written for Node's built-in test runner. Explain memory-leak pitfalls.
Implement a trie in Rust supporting insert, contains, starts_with and delete, with unit tests. Explain ownership choices for the child nodes.
Write a Python command-line tool using argparse that counts word frequencies across text files, supports a top-N flag and case folding, and includes tests. Explain the design.
Implement quicksort and mergesort in C, with a benchmark harness that sorts random arrays of several sizes and verifies the output. Discuss stability and worst cases.
Write a Kotlin data class for a bank account with deposit, withdraw and transfer functions that enforce invariants, plus JUnit tests. Explain how you prevent negative balances.
Implement a thread-safe bounded blocking queue in Java using ReentrantLock and two Conditions, with a producer-consumer demo. Explain why two conditions are used.
Write a Python async web scraper skeleton with aiohttp that fetches a list of URLs with a concurrency limit, retries with backoff, and collects results. Explain each part.
Implement a union-find (disjoint set) structure in C++ with path compression and union by rank, then use it to count connected components. Include tests and complexity notes.
Write a Go HTTP server with handlers for creating, listing and deleting todo items stored in memory behind a mutex, plus tests using httptest. Explain the concurrency model.
Implement matrix multiplication in Python three ways: naive loops, list comprehensions, and NumPy, and write a benchmark comparing them. Explain the performance differences.
Write a Rust program that reads lines from stdin, parses each as an arithmetic expression with +, -, *, / and parentheses using a recursive descent parser, and prints results. Include tests.
Implement a simple tokenizer and recursive descent parser in Python for JSON, without using the json module, returning nested dicts and lists. Include tests for tricky inputs.
Write a TypeScript class implementing an in-memory key-value store with TTL expiry, lazy and periodic cleanup, and Jest tests using fake timers. Explain the tradeoffs.
Implement the Knuth-Morris-Pratt string search algorithm in Java, including the failure-function construction, with tests and a step-by-step trace on an example.
Write a C program that implements a hash map with open addressing and linear probing for string keys, including resize, insert, lookup and delete with tombstones. Include tests.
Implement a breadth-first and a depth-first search on a grid maze in Python, returning the path, and print the maze with the path marked. Explain why BFS finds shortest paths.
Write a Bash script that backs up a directory into timestamped tar.gz archives, keeps only the newest N, logs to a file, and handles errors. Explain each command.
Implement a token bucket rate limiter in Go that is safe for concurrent use, with tests that use a fake clock. Explain how refill is computed.
Write a Python class for a 2D vector with operator overloading, normalization, dot and cross products, and full unit tests. Explain each dunder method.
Implement topological sort in C++ using Kahn's algorithm, detecting cycles, with tests on several DAGs. Then implement the DFS-based variant and compare.
Write a Swift struct for a stack and a queue built from two stacks, with generic element types and XCTest-style tests. Explain amortized complexity.
Implement a simple regular expression matcher in Python supporting literals, '.', '*', '^' and '$', using recursion. Include tests and explain the backtracking.
Write a Java program that reads a CSV file of transactions, aggregates totals per customer with streams, and prints a sorted report. Include unit tests and explain the stream pipeline.
Implement a bloom filter in Rust with configurable size and number of hash functions, a function to estimate the false positive rate, and tests. Explain the math.
Write a C++ program that computes the convex hull of a set of 2D points using Andrew's monotone chain, with tests and an explanation of the cross-product orientation test.
Implement a Python decorator that memoizes function results with an optional maximum size and time-to-live, preserving the function signature. Include tests and explain the internals.
Write a Go program that walks a directory tree concurrently with a worker pool, computes SHA-256 hashes of all files, and reports duplicates. Explain the synchronization.
Implement a red-black tree insertion in Java with all rotation and recoloring cases, plus a validator that checks the red-black properties. Explain each case.
Write a TypeScript implementation of a promise pool that runs async tasks with a maximum concurrency and returns results in input order. Include tests and explain the scheduling.
Implement the Levenshtein edit distance in Rust with full DP and with a two-row memory optimization, and reconstruct the edit script. Include tests.
Write a Python implementation of the game of life on a toroidal grid, with a step function, a text renderer, and tests for still lifes and oscillators. Explain the rules.
Implement a simple stack-based virtual machine in C with push, add, sub, mul, jump and conditional jump instructions, plus a sample program and tests. Explain the dispatch loop.
Write a Java Spring-style REST controller (plain Java, no framework) design for a library system with books and loans, including classes, validation and unit tests. Explain the layering.
Implement k-means clustering in Python with NumPy from scratch, including k-means++ initialization and convergence checks, plus a demo on synthetic data. Explain the algorithm.
Write a Rust implementation of a generic binary search tree with insert, search, in-order traversal and removal, using Option<Box<Node>>. Include tests and explain borrowing issues.
Implement a sliding window maximum function in C++ using a deque, with tests and a detailed explanation of why it runs in linear time.
Write a Go implementation of a consistent hashing ring with virtual nodes, adding and removing servers, and key lookup. Include tests showing key movement is minimal.
Implement a Python generator pipeline that reads a large log file lazily, filters error lines, parses timestamps, and aggregates counts per hour. Include tests and explain laziness.
Write a C function that converts an integer to its English words representation, handling zero, negatives and up to billions, with a test harness. Explain the decomposition.
Implement the A* search algorithm in Python on a weighted grid with a Manhattan heuristic, returning the path and cost, with tests. Explain admissibility and consistency.
Write a TypeScript reducer and action types for a shopping cart (add, remove, change quantity, clear) with full type safety and unit tests. Explain discriminated unions.
Implement a fixed-size thread pool in C++ with std::thread, a task queue, futures for results, and graceful shutdown. Include a demo and explain the condition variable usage.
Write a Java implementation of the producer-consumer pattern using a BlockingQueue, with multiple producers and consumers and a poison-pill shutdown. Explain the termination logic.
Implement run-length encoding and decoding in Rust for byte slices, handling long runs, with property-style tests that decode(encode(x)) == x. Explain the format.
Write a Python implementation of a simple bank ledger using double-entry bookkeeping with accounts, transactions and a trial balance check. Include tests and explain the invariants.
Implement a segment tree in C++ supporting range sum queries and point updates, then extend it with lazy propagation for range additions. Include tests.
Write a Go program that implements a simple key-value store with a write-ahead log for durability, recovery on startup, and tests. Explain the crash-safety reasoning.
Implement the Sieve of Eratosthenes in Python, then a segmented sieve for large ranges, with tests and a discussion of memory and time complexity.
Write a JavaScript function that deep-clones objects, arrays, Dates, Maps, Sets and handles circular references, with tests. Explain the approach.
Implement a simple Markdown-to-HTML converter in Python supporting headings, bold, italics, links, code spans and lists, with tests. Explain the parsing strategy.
Write a C program that implements a dynamic array (vector) for ints with push, pop, insert, remove and automatic growth, plus tests and an explanation of amortized growth.
Implement a Rust function that tokenizes and evaluates Reverse Polish Notation expressions with proper error handling via Result, plus tests. Explain the error types.
Write a Java class that implements a simple in-memory full-text search index with tokenization, an inverted index, and ranked results by term frequency. Include tests.
warmup: Write a Python function that checks whether a string is a palindrome, ignoring punctuation and case, with tests and an explanation.
Write a C function that computes the greatest common divisor of two integers using Euclid's algorithm, with tests and a proof sketch.
Implement FizzBuzz in Rust in three different styles and explain the tradeoffs of each.
Write a Go function that reverses the words in a sentence, with table-driven tests and an explanation.
Write a TypeScript function that flattens nested arrays to any depth, with types and tests, and explain the recursion.
Implement a stack in Java using an array with automatic resizing, with tests and an explanation of amortized cost.
Write a Python function that converts Roman numerals to integers and back, with tests and an explanation of the rules.
Write a C++ function that rotates a matrix by 90 degrees in place, with tests and an explanation of the layer approach.
